criteria.criterion: A normal numeric id returns an existing teaching row.
criteria.evidence:
GET /Less-1/index.php?id=1 returns HTTP 200 (721 bytes), body shows 'Your Login name:Dumb
Your Password:Dumb'.

criteria.criterion: The boolean-true payload returns the same row while changing only id.
criteria.evidence: Payload id=1' AND '1'='1 returns HTTP 200, 721 bytes, identical response_sha256 (14fec1f7...b779) to the normal case, same 'Dumb' row; only the id value changed.

criteria.criterion: The boolean-false payload returns no user row, showing SQL semantics changed.
criteria.evidence: Payload id=1' AND '1'='2 returns HTTP 200 but 670 bytes, different sha256 (cf6c5452...dc29), and the body contains an empty <font color= "#FFFF00"></font> with no Login name/Password row.

criteria.criterion: No authentication or redirect is involved in this endpoint.
criteria.evidence: All three requests are unauthenticated GETs with empty cookie_names, return 200 directly, and response headers carry no Location/Set-Cookie or challenge; no login page or 3xx in evidence.

rationale: 正常 id=1 与布尔真载荷的响应逐字节一致，均为 721 字节、同一 sha256 与同一 'Dumb' 行；布尔假载荷同样返回 200 但仅 670 字节且行内容为空，说明注入的 AND 条件改变了 SQL 语义而非请求被服务端拒绝或重定向。三请求均无 Cookie、无 Location/Set-Cookie，接口匿名直连，四项成功标准均被满足，故判定该条件触发 SQL 注入。
missing_evidence: No negative control on a non-injectable parameter or a payload designed to be syntactically invalid, to exclude a server-side input filter that happens to drop the row.
No repeated runs or response-time/timing evidence; only single-shot byte-level comparison is provided.
No evidence of database error text or row count/version enumeration to further corroborate SQL execution (only the observed logical difference).
Full untruncated response bodies are not shown, so it is not proven that the false case differs only in the row markup rather than in other page content.
Scope is limited to the Less-1 path and one database account; no evidence covering other endpoints or privilege levels.
